macros.name: disabledarkmode
macros.doc: \enabledarkmode enables the dark Mode at the current position, while \disabledarkmode disables the dark mode at the current position.

macros.name: enabledarkmode
macros.doc: \enabledarkmode enables the dark Mode at the current position, while \disabledarkmode disables the dark mode at the current position.

macros.name: IfDarkModeF
macros.doc: Checks whether the dark mode is enabled or not.

macros.name: IfDarkModeTF
macros.doc: Checks whether the dark mode is enabled or not. If so, ⟨true code⟩ is executed, otherwise ⟨false code⟩ is executed.
